title: MEG-SCANS - A comprehensive magnetoencephalography speech dataset with Stories, Chirps And Noisy Sentences.
description: MEG-SCANS provides raw and MaxFiltered magnetoencephalography recordings from 24 German-speaking participants who listened to about one hour of auditory stimuli. The stimuli were two audiobooks, 120 Oldenburg Matrix Sentence Test (OLSA) sentences at varying intelligibility levels, and short up-chirps for signal quality assessment. The dataset also includes empty-room recordings, structural MRI, audiograms, speech reception threshold results, and audio stimulus material. It is organized in BIDS and intended as a benchmark for encoding and decoding analyses of brain responses to speech.
methods_description: MEG was recorded from 24 participants during auditory listening to audiobooks, OLSA matrix sentences at intelligibility levels from 20% to 95%, and up-chirps. Auxiliary channels captured the left and right audio signals and the instructor's microphone at 1000 Hz. Pre- and post-session empty-room recordings, structural MRI, and behavioral audiogram and SRT hearing screenings were also collected. Raw data were additionally MaxFiltered.
